snippet.title: 'Can we panic now?' | Best Forbidden Forest Moments
snippet.description:
Thanks to its intensely spooky vibe, the Forbidden Forest is the last place anybody wants to be (unless you're Hagrid, that is). Yet, somehow, Harry has found himself there many a time in various states of peril. Whether that be coming face to face with Aragog and his very hungry children, saving Sirius Black from a swarm of Dementors, or seeing dragons up close and personal. Journey into the Forbidden Forest yourself if you dare, by rewatching every Forbidden Forest scene – just remember to pull yourself together and have your wits about you!
